short.zh: 每个路口都在重复同一件事
short.en: Every crossing does the same thing

t.zh: 城市的街道是棋盘格。所有街道都是单行道，只能往右或往下走。
t.en: This city’s streets form a grid. Every street is one-way: you can only go right or down.

t.zh: 除了最上面一行和最左边一列，每个路口都有两根箭头指过来：一根来自上面，一根来自左边。
t.en: Apart from the top row and the left column, every crossing has two arrows coming in: one from above and one from the left.

t.zh: 用<level-ref to="lastStep"></level-ref>的方法，把每个路口的路线数填出来。左上角的起点已经填好了 1。
t.en: Use the method from <level-ref to="lastStep"></level-ref> to fill in the number of routes to every crossing. The start in the top-left corner already holds 1.

goal.zh: 填出每个路口的路线数。街道只能往右或往下走，左上角的起点算 1 条，右下角就是路线总数。
goal.en: Fill in the number of routes to every crossing. Streets only go right or down; the start in the top-left corner counts as 1, and the bottom-right corner gives the total.

how.zh: 点一个路口，用数字键盘填数。
how.en: Click a crossing and type its number on the keypad.

body.zh: 回头看看你做了什么：12 个路口，每个都在做同一件事，上面的数 + 左边的数。
body.en: Look back at what you did: 12 crossings, and every one did the same thing: the number above + the number to the left.

body.zh: 填的顺序也有讲究：你一定是从左上往右下填的，因为一个路口要等上面和左边都填好了才能算。
body.en: The order mattered too: you filled from the top left towards the bottom right, because a crossing can only be worked out once the crossings above and to its left are filled.

body.zh: 把同一件事重复 12 次很无聊。城市有 100 个路口时，就更不可能手算了。
body.en: Doing the same thing 12 times is boring, and with 100 crossings it would be hopeless by hand.

note.zh: 棋盘城市里，每个路口 = 上面的路口 + 左边的路口。
note.en: In a grid city, each crossing = the crossing above + the crossing to the left.
